summary: Deadline discipline throughout: one end-to-end budget per read/create/edit (queue wait included), per-request remaining-time clamps under the 120s MCP timeout, refusal instead of clamped late mutations; stub hydration whole-pass budget; handle maps capped with FIFO eviction and reuse refresh.
residual_risks: 45s Slack timeouts are static; no adaptive backoff on ratelimited (surfaced as retryable errors).
